recommendation: Keep this core audit commit. If further cleanup is desired, update THO/UTG CodeSystem-referencerange-meaning to replace 'in otherwords' with 'in other words' or another WG-approved grammatical phrasing.
issue_request: FHIR-16809 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for STU3 Observation asking to fix grammar in the Observation Reference Range Meaning CodeSystem abstract property description.
initial_application: Commit 468774c1b07865f7af97bf1643874d2e37067aaf explicitly applied GF#16809 in historical core source/observation/codesystem-referencerange-meaning.xml, changing the original 'that is' wording to 'in otherwords'.
additional_context: The CodeSystem source file was deleted from FHIR core by the UTG migration commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8. Current core keeps Observation active and binds Observation.referenceRange.type to ValueSet/referencerange-meaning, whose source includes the external THO system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/referencerange-meaning. The current THO JSON still contains the 'in otherwords' wording.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The authoritative CodeSystem property description is now in external terminology content, so this core reconciliation records the ownership boundary and recommends an external THO/UTG follow-up if the grammar should still be corrected.
